explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/306 with the reported positive answer [Li26], with a formal proof linked. Every positive rational with squarefree denominator is a sum of reciprocals of distinct integers, each a product of two distinct primes (ω = Ω = 2). The Fin (k+1) encoding with n₀ = 1 and strict monotonicity gives distinct denominators > 1.
